summary: Hipcamp listing (the only booking channel; no operator website found) is LIVE and bookable: 38 full-hookup pull-thru RV sites at $50 ($55 for three) host price plus a $5 Hipcamp fee (all-in $55-$60), 2 tent sites, 10-night max. Fees confirmed with a corrected fee note (flat $5, not ~18%); booking, sites (40, rigs to 70 ft, pull-through) and water/sewer hookups recorded. AWH's '$56+fees' dropped as redundant/out of date.
flags: Price gate (family has not stayed here): the all-in nightly price for an RV site is $55 ($50 host price + mandatory $5 Hipcamp service fee; three sites $60) before tax, over US$50. gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest: Shenandoah NP 86 km; Seneca Rocks / Spruce Knob-Seneca Rocks NRA and Dolly Sods are not on its gateway list) and no family home. Possible DROP; human decides.

No operator website: none found (only Hipcamp, Outdoorsy, The Dyrt). The Dyrt's URL slug is 'country-roads-campground-wv', suggesting an earlier name. Missing phone: Hipcamp publishes none; The Dyrt gives the address 117 Poor Farm Road, Cabins, WV 26855.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the listing says 'roll out your tent by the river' and 'over 20 RV and campsites with riverfront access'; the entry is 'riverfront' while AWH's note says 'Sites are not waterfront'. The two stored statements disagree with each other.
Facilities unsettled: the listing's amenity list includes Showers and Toilets, but its description says 'we're expanding our features ... with a bathhouse and laundry room coming soon'. Not recorded.
